# mac_service (Resource)

`mac_service` manages a service using [launchctl](https://www.manpagez.com/man/1/launchctl/).

It controls macOS services by loading, unloading, and optionally starting them via `launchctl`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label` (String) The label of the launchctl service, usually defined in the plist.
- `plist` (String) Absolute path to the service plist file.

### Optional

- `start` (Boolean) Whether to immediately start the service after loading.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID of the service resource.
